name: Floragato
description: Floragato, the Grass Cat Pokémon, and the evolved form of Sprigatito. Able to evolve into Meowscarada. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
